text:
Rosa: Quick ask 1: We need a final copy pass for the three landing pages (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) this morning. Focus: concise hero (one line), single benchmark hint, webinar CTA, and the form -> CRM routing spec. 9am sync to approve.
Ethan: Im good at 9. Ill bring the latest perf snippets from the lab run.
Priya: Ill write 2 hero variations per mode and a micro-subhead line to sit under each hero. Posting drafts in a sec.
Luke: From ops: please be explicit about product labels: use "Hosted API", "Redwood Dedicated", and "Private (VPC & on-prem)". Also flag any KMS/HSM phrasing for security.
FormBot: Created meeting: https://calendar.example/event/1765054321. Reminder +1h.
Rosa: Perfect. Priya include a one-line metric (latency or throughput) we can link to a bench doc. Keep it short.
Priya: Draft heroes and subheads (2 variants each):

Hosted V1: "Hosted API: Launch LLM features in hours"
Subhead: "Low-latency text, chat, and embeddings with streaming + usage insights."
Hosted V2: "API-first inference, zero infra management"
Subhead: "Predictable p95 latency for interactive experiences."

Dedicated V1: "Redwood Dedicated: reserved GPU lanes for production"
Subhead: "Consistent throughput and pinable model versions."
Dedicated V2: "Committed capacity, predictable SLAs"
Subhead: "Autoscale policies and canary rollouts for safe launches."

Private V1: "Private (VPC & on-prem): your network, our runtime"
Subhead: "Customer-managed keys, audit trail, and on-prem options."
Private V2: "Bring Redwood inside your perimeter"
Subhead: "Full control over data residency and integrations."

Priya: Suggested micro-metrics under each hero (one short line): Hosted: "p95 ~150ms (8k context, interactive)"; Dedicated: "sustained 30k tokens/min per pool"; Private: "identical runtime, private network". Thoughts?
Ethan: For Hosted let's use the lab canonical: "p95 135ms on chat-8k" 1 (link to bench will follow). For Dedicated, use the aggregated pool metric but avoid per-hour pricing on public pages.
Luke: Routing rules for webinar signups: map leads into three buckets by employee_count: >=2000 -> Enterprise Sales; 500-1999 -> AE queue; <500 -> Growth/Mkt. Also include deployment_interest field ("Hosted", "Dedicated", "Private"). If deployment_interest=="Private" and employee_count>=500 -> prioritize Enterprise Sales.
Rosa: Can you paste a sample webhook payload so forms team can wire it? Keep field names simple.
Luke: sample payload (paste below):

```
{
  "email": "jane@acme.co",
  "full_name": "Jane Doe",
  "employee_count": 1200,
  "company": "Acme Co",
  "deployment_interest": "Dedicated",
  "utm_source": "launch-apr-2026"
}
```

Priya: CTA copy options for the webinar/form: "Reserve a seat  live benchmark & Q&A" / "See the launch demo: performance, rollout, pricing model" / "Join demo: build + deploy patterns" 1 which converts best?
Ethan: Prefer the first and third. Short line under CTA: "Includes live benchmark walkthrough + 15-min office hours"  helps set expectations.
Rosa: Legal note (Luke): avoid phrase "pricing model" on public hero. Use "cost controls" or "unit economics" if needed.
Luke: Noted. Also change "HSM" to "customer-managed keys (CMK)" in Private copy to match glossary.
Priya: Revised Private subhead to use "audit trail" and "customer-managed keys".
Luke: Form mappings: map deployment_interest -> contact.tags and employee_count -> contact.size_bucket. Example tag values: hosted, dedicated, private.
FormBot: Registration form: https://forms.example/launch-apr-2026 created. Mapped fields: email, full_name, company, employee_count, deployment_interest, utm_source. Webhook endpoint drafted.
Ethan: I'll push the bench doc links into this thread after the 8:30 run. Use that to populate micro-metric links.
Priya: Action items: Ill pick Hosted V1, Dedicated V2, Private V2 as final heroes, add the subheads and the micro-metrics with bench links. Luke to post routing GH issue + webhook spec. Ethan to paste bench doc links. FormOps to wire form fields to webhook. 9am review confirmers: @Ethan @Priya @Luke.
Rosa: Great. If we lock these today, we can stage the pages and launch the webinar with the registration CTA in the hero. :rocket:
Ethan: Roger that.
Priya: Posting staged mock in design channel in 30m.
Luke: Ill open the routing GH issue and tag eng-forms.
FormBot: Reminder set for 9am review.
Rosa: Thanks team  see you at review.
